Hi Priyom / Ben,

Quick context — we have a coordinated maintenance and migration for our ingestion pipeline planned for next Tue (2026-09-29) 02:00–06:00 PT. During the rollout we expect an elevated rate of P1/P2 incidents tied to schema changes and ephemeral node churn.

We need Redwood to approve a short, scoped SLA adjustment for that maintenance window:
- P1: maintain best-effort 45–60 minute response (instead of contractual 30m) if incidents require deeper investigation and hands-on shadowing by our SREs.
- P2: extend response window from 4h to 6h for the 4-hour maintenance window.
- Provide a dedicated on-call shadow (Redwood SRE) for the 48 hours centered on the maintenance window (24h before / 24h after).

Why we’re asking: the upstream change will cause a flurry of false-positive alerts and noisy retries; our team will be hands-on and we need coordinated cross-org triage to avoid repeated escalations. We can provide a runbook and a dedicated on-call list on our side.

If approved we'll sign an amendment or statement of work and share the runbook up front. We are also open to a small standby credit in case the adjustment results in additional cost to Redwood.

Attachments: datagrid_incidents_q2.csv (recent incident summary), proposed-runbook.md (draft)

Can you confirm feasibility and what approvals are needed by EOD Monday?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera

2) The runbook must include a named point-of-contact at DataGrid for every escalation tier (email + mobile).
3) The amendment needs a defined rollback clause and a cap on standby credits.

Operational proposal from our side (placeholder while we confirm approvals):
- P1: commit to 45 min response SLA during the 4-hour maintenance window, with guaranteed presence of a Redwood SRE on the triage bridge for at least 2 hours overlapping the peak migration.
- P2: temporarily move to a 6-hour response window for the same window.
- Dedicated shadowing: we can provide a single SRE shadow shift covering 48 hours, ops to be scheduled with Ben.

Ben — can you confirm on-call availability and whether we can staff a shadow for 48 hours? Marissa — looping you in for approval on the credit cap and contractual amendment.

I can draft the amendment (DocuSign) once we have the POC and window.
